title: CS 4535: Checkpoint 1
description: Due Tue Oct 13, 23:59 ET. Judgment returned by Mon Oct 19.
completedHtml:
Checkpoint 1 submitted.

Your team's review and your individual feedback come back by Mon Oct 19. Standup #2 is in the room on Wed Oct 14.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: About 10 minutes if your work is committed. Where you can, paste a link. We read this alongside your team's review and send back a written judgment by Mon Oct 19: on track or not, and why. See Project Milestones & Checkpoints.

choices.text: Early: as a sprint objective or right after it
Mid-project, on a prototype (Oct 14 to Nov 5)
